biography.background:
Kir'Ven est un Thriik Leader, un "Envoy". Sa présence et ses ordres inpirent ses alliés à donner plus d'eux-mêmes et à exploiter les points faibles de vos adversaires. Lorsque c'est nécessaire, il s'interpose entre les ennemis et ses alliés.

Comment jouer Kir'Ven ?

  • Votre psyché insectoïde vous permet de profiter de l'aide apportée à vos alliés, ainsi que de ressentir ce qu'ils ressentent.

  • Utilisez vos @UUID[Compendium.daggerheart-scifi-content.character-options.z87N0emUQuSgtkbm]{Command Tokens} afin de donner des avantages avec un d8 à vos alliés (au lieu d'un d6).

  • Désignez votre adversaire principal avec @UUID[Compendium.daggerheart-scifi-content.character-options.57mfPuIM0De08TPG]{You're Next!} et donnez un avantage à vos alliés !

  • Demander du @UUID[Compendium.daggerheart-scifi-content.character-options.JphikpoMjKUk0Hid]{Feedback} à votre équipe, ce qui leur permet de gagner du Hope ou retirer du Stress. Et à vous aussi.

  • En tant que Capitaine, vos ordres utilisant des Command Token permettent de donner un meilleur avantage à leurs actions.

  • Vos paroles inspirantes aussi, leur permettent de retirer du Stress, gagner du Hope et même des HP !

system.description: After a successful attack, Spend 3 Hope to make the target Vulnerable. You then give the Spotlight to an ally. The GM cannot take the spotlight before your ally ended theirs.

Once per session, every PC in your party can comment your leadership:

  • If they say something nice, they can gain a Hope.

  • If they say something disobliging, they can clear a Stress.

Once everyone has made a comment, you can gain a Hope or clear a Stress.

You now have the Words of Encouragement downtime activity.

During a short rest, describe how you encourage an aaly to keep going, then they can clear a number of Stress equal to 1d4 + your tier.

Some people lead through rank. Others lead through fear. A real Leader leads through confidence, daring, and instinct. They inspire allies to push harder, exploit every weakness in the enemy's line, and turn a single opening into a decisive victory.
When you Help an ally, you also gain a Hope if they roll with Hope.
Once per Scene, after an ally succeeds on an Instinct Roll, you also learn what they learned.
You have Advantage on rolls to negotiate contracts, leverage bureaucracy, or interact with corporate officials.

When an adversary makes any roll targetting one of your allies and before the dice are rolled, you can spend a Command Token to impose disadvantage on that action. The disadvantage die is a d8 (instead of a d6).

When an ally within Very Close range makes a Action Roll but before the consequences are determined, you can spend a Command Token to make that ally roll again. They must keep the new result and you may not use another Command Token for that action.

At the beginning of each session, gain a number of Command Tokens depending on your Tier:

Whenever you Help an Ally, you may spend a Command Token to use a d8 advantage instead of a d6.
Once per long rest, you may deliver a speech of authority, moral clarity or fierce conviction. All allies within Far range clear 2 Stress.
Insectoid beings who thrive through cooperation and shared purpose.
Play the Envoy if you want to make speeches, empower your allies, and make teamwork your greatest weapon.

Being part of a corporateborne community means you were raised within the influence of a megacorporation. Whether as an executive's child or a factory worker, you learned that favors, contracts, and reputation often matter more than laws.

Corporateborne are often ambitious, composed, persuasive, polished, and calculating.

When an ally within Very Close range would take damage, you can mark a Stress to stand in the way and make yourself the target of the attack instead. When you take damage from this attack, you can mark any number of Armor Slots.

system.description:
Your speech is imbued with power. After a long rest, place a number of tokens on this card equal to your Presence. When you speak with an ally, you can spend a token from this card to give them one benefit from the following options:

  • Your ally clears a Stress.

  • Your ally clears a Hit Point.

  • Your ally gains a Hope.

When you take a long rest, clear all unspent tokens.
